question: What Are the Main Types of Instrumentation in Process Plants?
body_html:
Types of instrumentation are grouped by the process parameter they measure or control, so plants can run safely, efficiently and consistently.

TypeMeasuresExamples
PressureForce of liquid or gas on a surfaceBourdon gauges, pressure transmitters, pressure switches
TemperatureHeat level of the processThermocouples, RTDs
FlowRate of fluid movementDP flow meters
LevelHeight of liquid or solidsLevel transmitters
AnalyticalChemical propertiesProcess analyzers
